Dashboard: Hero Figures Without Repetition

The proposed website Dashboard, 6 Oct 2026, branch feat/dashboard-audit-fixes. Before is commit 8edef190; After is this change. Every figure and label is the Department's, unchanged.

All India, desktop

Before
The panel showed NMBA and the ₹67,977 Cr total only; the cards led with the cumulative 9 Cr, 11 Cr and 14,757
After
The panel carries all four Department figures again (₹67,977 Cr, 9 Cr, 11 Cr, 14,757), each labelled with its card; the cards lead with their latest year: 74.23 lakh and 56.47 lakh students in 2025-26 (provisional), and SHREYAS's Latest Year (2025-26), 2,506
Why
The panel answers "how many since 2014-15"; the cards answer "how many this year". Each figure appears once.
